name: 2020-2c-parcial1-cryptic3
title: W1 Games: W2 and W6 refactoring (cryptic names, hidden domain)
description: A point-and-click adventure engine with a Backpack that stores portable objects (with weight and game points), a PlayableCharacter and Doors with three states. The student must remove duplicated loops in Backpack accessing, replace the isKindOf: ifs in Backpack>>add: with polymorphism, redesign Door with state objects (a DoorState class is given as a starting point) and remove duplication in some tests. Cryptic twin: every class, selector, variable, symbol and string the exercise's author named is replaced by a meaningless one (level 3), comments removed; renames.json has the table. Level 3: the words of the author's names are also replaced in the statement, so the domain is hidden.

design.notes: Three classic refactorings in one: index-based whileTrue: loops to inject:into:/detect-style collection protocol, isKindOf: dispatch to double dispatch on PortableObject subclasses, and a symbol-based Door state (with a key check nested inside) to State objects, all while keeping the given tests untouched.
